mentions.name: TradeyHQ
mentions.description: This app is a simple job management tool for busy tradespeople to keep track of their jobs, with quick and easy lead capture. It is not launched yet and is being refined.
mentions.problem: Time-pressed tradespeople do most of their admin in the evenings and need an easy, quick way to track jobs and capture leads.
mentions.audience: Busy, time-pressed tradespeople who do most of their admin in the evenings.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building https://tradeyhq.com/

It’s a super simple job management app for busy tradespeople to keep track of jobs.

The main use case is time pressed tradespeople who do most of their admin in the evenings.

The app makes capturing leads incredibly easy and quick.
